decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s) shall be installed in the  flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.

<p><span style="font-size: inherit;">Notwithstanding the details shown on the approved plans,&nbsp;</span>the development shall not progress beyond damp proof course<i>&nbsp;</i><span data-teams="true" style="">until amended plans showing the following details have first been submitted to and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority</span><span style="font-size: inherit;">:</span></p><p><span style="font-size: inherit;">i.&nbsp; a brick on edge on tile creasing parapet&nbsp;</span></p><p><span style="font-size: inherit;">ii.&nbsp; the proposed prominent rooflights omitted or reduced in height</span></p><p><span data-teams="true">The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details so agreed and shall be retained as such thereafter.&nbsp;</span></p>

<p><span style="font-size: inherit;">Notwithstanding the approved plans, all new brickwork, including the brickwork bond, pointing, roof tiles, external works and finishes shall match the existing adjacent work with regard to the methods used and material, colour, size, texture and profile.</span></p><p><span data-teams="true"></span></p><p><br></p>
description: Single storey side to rear extension; conversion of garage to habitable room
